system: mixed system of civil, customary, and Islamic religious law

constitution.history: ratified by the Constituent Assembly 23 May 1997 (never implemented)
constitution.amend: proposed by the president of Eritrea or by assent of at least one half of the National Assembly membership; passage requires at least an initial three-quarters majority vote by the Assembly and, after one year, final passage by at least four-fifths majority vote by the Assembly

courts.highest: High Court (consists of 20 judges and organized into civil, commercial, criminal, labor, administrative, and customary sections)
courts.judges: High Court judges appointed by the president
courts.lower: regional/zonal courts; community courts; special courts; sharia courts (for issues dealing with Muslim marriage, inheritance, and family); military courts

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Eritrea

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
